en-US.promotionalText: See more, side by side. Explore 120 art and design styles with Guided Looking, flexible layouts, daily reminders and Home Screen widgets.
en-US.whatsNew:
More room to look, without losing your place.

- Guided Looking places artwork and prompts side by side in wider windows.
- Rotation and iPad window resizing preserve your reading passage and guide step.
- Improved landscape, large-text and subscription offer presentation.

Style Atlas Plus now shows eligible introductory terms directly from the App Store, including the standard renewal price that follows. There is no introductory free trial in this campaign. Existing legacy Plus purchases remain recognized.
en-US.descriptionCommerceCorrection:
Plus offers two auto-renewing plans:
• Monthly: eligible subscribers may receive a paid first-month introductory offer, then the standard monthly price until cancelled.
• Annual: eligible subscribers may receive a paid first-year introductory offer, then the standard annual price until cancelled.

Current localized prices, eligibility and renewal terms are shown by the App Store in the purchase screen. This campaign does not include a free trial.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 屏幕更宽，看得更完整。探索 120 种艺术与设计风格，让作品与看图引导并排呈现；旋转或调整窗口后继续阅读，还有每日风格提醒与桌面小组件。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
多一点空间，看图不丢思路。

- 宽屏下，作品与看图引导并排显示。
- 旋转 iPhone 或调整 iPad 窗口后，保留当前阅读段落与导览步骤。
- 优化横屏、大字号与订阅优惠信息的展示。

Style Atlas Plus 现在会直接显示 App Store 返回的首期优惠资格、优惠价格和之后的原价续费信息。本次活动不含免费试用；既有 Plus 购买权益继续有效。
zh-Hans.descriptionCommerceCorrection:
Plus 提供两种自动续订方案：
• 连续包月：符合资格时可享付费首月优惠，之后按月原价续费，可随时取消。
• 连续包年：符合资格时可享付费首年优惠，之后按年原价续费，可随时取消。

购买页会显示 App Store 返回的当前本地价格、优惠资格与续费条款。本次活动不含免费试用。

reviewNotes:
Style Atlas V1.6 (17) replaces the earlier build 16 subscription presentation. No account or sign-in is required.

The Plus purchase screen reads each product's localized standard price, introductory-offer eligibility, localized offer price, payment mode and duration from StoreKit. It advertises an introductory offer only when StoreKit provides a complete eligible offer; otherwise it shows only the standard price. The campaign uses paid-up-front introductory offers, not a free trial:
- Monthly: first month at the localized introductory price, then the standard monthly price.
- Annual: first year at the localized introductory price, then the standard annual price.

Suggested review path:
1. Tap a Plus-locked section or Open the complete style archive.
2. Review the annual option selected by default, including its first-year and subsequent annual prices.
3. Select the monthly option and review its first-month and subsequent monthly prices.
4. Complete a sandbox purchase, then test Restore Purchases.
5. Test language switching, favorites, export ratios, device rotation, iPad resizing, widgets and the opt-in 9:00 AM local reminder.

StoreKit products:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_monthly_auto
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual_auto

Legacy products remain recognized only for existing purchasers:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_lifetime

Purchases use StoreKit / the App Review test environment; no test account is required. Product IDs, subscription group, entitlements and standard prices are unchanged.
